probes.check: am_probe_tracy_diagnostics(): the Tracy client is running, and a zone opened and closed through the facade adds its begin and end events to the calling thread's queue in the client, which holds them while no profiler is connected.

seeded_violation.description: Return from am_profiling_slot_zone_begin() without opening a Tracy zone.

adaptation_notes: Tracy fills the profiling slot: each zone the diagnostics facade opens, from any library's profile hook (such as enkiTS's wait callbacks), becomes a tracy::ScopedZone named by the facade, kept on a per-thread stack until the facade closes it.
The zones' names are copied into Tracy's source locations at runtime, so a library may pass names that don't outlive the zone.
Tracy has no log or assert hook of its own to route; its internal messages are turned off with TRACY_NO_INTERNAL_MESSAGE, which no probe checks.
